name: Elder's Reckoning

attributes.description:
The long edge bears the reckoning of forgotten halls.

Frontal Sweep: 12% chance on a successful normal weapon attack to sweep the three tiles in front of you, striking up to two additional enemies for 50% physical attack damage each, up to 24 each. Cooldown: 12 seconds.
Legendary weapon cooldowns are shared by your character. Extra damage is based on the original attack before critical bonuses and mitigation; armor, resistance and player damage rules still apply.
